{"command": "PYTHONPATH=/home/agent/workspace/.pylibs python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
from shapely.geometry import shape
from shapely.validation import explain_validity

with open('/home/agent/workspace/invalid_polygon.geojson') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

geom = shape(data['features'][0]['geometry'])
print('geometry type :', geom.geom_type)
print('is_valid      :', geom.is_valid)
print('is_ring       :', geom.exterior.is_ring)
print('is_closed     :', geom.exterior.is_closed)
print('explain       :', explain_validity(geom))
print('ring coords   :', list(geom.exterior.coords))
EOF", "timeout": 60}
